svg.aria-label: Hero summary. GLLA median 660.5 seconds, range 622.2 to 698.7. pi-goal-x median 363.9 seconds, range 297.7 to 430.0. That is 1.8 times the wall clock. Cost per run: 0.157 dollars versus 0.049. Tokens: 233 thousand versus 96 thousand. Both passed 16 of 16 tests. No overall winner is declared.
